senses.gloss: 1. ए॑त (for 2. See s.v.) mfn. come near, approached, RV.; Nir. &c.
2. ए॑त (for 1. See 4. ए) mf(आ and ए॑नी, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 39)n. (√ इ, Uṇ. iii, 86), ‘rushing’, ‘darting’
of a variegated colour, varying the colour, shining, brilliant, RV.; AV.; TS.; VS. &c.
ए॑त m. a kind of deer or antelope, RV.
the hide of the same, RV.
variegated colour, T.
ए॑ता f. a hind, MBh. iii, 8384
एत—ग्व mfn. of variegated colour, shining (said of horses), RV. i, 115, 3; vii, 70, 2; viii, 70, 7.
एतक mf(इका, एनिका)n. = ए॑त above, Pat.
ए॑तश nd एतश॑, amfn. of variegated colour, shining, brilliant (said of Brahmaṇas-pati), RV. x, 53, 9
ए॑तश (अस्), m. a horse of variegated colour, dappled horse (esp. said of the Sun's horse), RV.
N. of a man (protected by Indra), RV.
a Brāhman, Uṇ. iii, 149.
एतशस् m. a Brāhman, Uṇ.

एत॑द् mfn. (Gr. 223; g. सर्वादि, Pāṇ. i, 1, 27) this, this here, here (especially as pointing to what is nearest to the speaker, e.g. एष बाणः, this arrow here in my hand; एष याति पन्थाः, here passes the way; एष कालः, here i.e. now, is the time; एतद्, this here i.e. this world here below)

sometimes used to give emphasis to the personal pronouns (e.g. एषोऽहम्, I, this very person here) or with omission of those pronouns (e.g. एष त्वां स्वर्गं नयामि, I standing here will convey thee to heaven; एतौ प्रविष्टौ स्वः, we two here have entered)
as the subject of a sentence it agrees in gender and number with the predicate without reference to the noun to be supplied (e.g. एतद् एव हि मे धनम्, for this [scil. cow] is my only wealth, MBh.)
but sometimes the neuter sing. remains (e.g. एतद् गुरुषु वृत्तिः, this is the custom among Gurus, Mn. ii, 206)

एतद् generally refers to what precedes, esp. when connected with इदम्, the latter then referring to what follows (e.g. एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः । अनुकल्पस् त्व् अयं ज्ञेयः, this before-mentioned is the principal rule, but this following may be considered a secondary rule, Mn. iii, 147)

it refers also to that which follows, esp. when connected with a relative clause (e.g. एष चैव गुरुर् धर्मो यम् प्रवक्ष्याम्य् अहं तव, this is the important law, which I will proclaim to you, MBh.), RV. &c. &c.
एत॑द् ind. in this manner, thus, so, here, at this time, now (e.g. न॑ वा॑ उ एत॑न् म्रियसे, thou dost not die in this manner or by that, RV. i, 162, 21), AV.; VS.; &c.;
एतद् [cf. Zd. aêta; Old Pers. aita; Armen. aid; Osk. eiso.]
एतद्—अतिरिक्त mfn. besides this.
एतद्—अन्त mfn. terminating with this, ending thus, Mn. i, 50.
एतद्—अर्थम् ind. on this account, for this end, therefore, Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.
(एतद् — अर्थं यद्, to this end — that, R.)
एतद्—अवधि ind. to this limit, so far.
एतद्—अवस्थ mfn. of such a state or condition, Vikr.; Ratnāv.
एतद्—आत्म्य n., ChUp. vi, 8, 7, misprint for ऐतदात्म्य (q.v.; cf. Śaṃkara's Comm. on the passage).
एतद्—आदि mfn. beginning with this, and so forth.
एतद्—उपनिषद् mfn. following this Upaniṣad, ChUp.
एतद्—दा॑ mfn. granting or bestowing this, ŚBr. ix.
एतद्—देवत्य॑ mfn. having this as deity, ŚBr. viii.
एतद्—द्वितीय mfn. doing this for the second time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.
एतद्—योनि mfn. of this origin, Bhag.
एतद्—वत् ind. like this, thus.
एतज् (in comp. for एतद्).
एतज्—ज mfn. arising from this.
एतत् (in comp. for एतद्).
एतत्—कालम् ind. now.
एतत्—˚कालीन mfn. belonging to or happening in the present time.
एतत्—क्षणात् ind. from this moment, henceforth
एतत्—क्षणे ind. in this moment, now.
एतत्—तुल्य mfn. similar to this.
एतत्—तृतीय mfn. doing this for the third time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.
एतत्—पर mfn. intent on or absorbed in this Comm. on Mn.
एतत्—प्रथम mfn. doing this for the first time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.
एतत्-प्रभृति mfn. beginning with this, Gobh.
एतत्—सम mfn. equal to this.
एतत्—समीप n. presence of this one.
एतदीय mfn. belonging or relating to this (person or thing), Kathās.; Hcat. &c.
एतन् (by Sandhi for एतद्).
एतन्—म॑य mf(ई)n. made or consisting of this, of such a kind, ŚBr.; AitBr.
एत॑र्हि ind. now, at this time, at present, nowadays, TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.
then (correlating to य॑र्हि), ib.
एत॑र्हि (इ), n. a measure of time (fifteen Idānis, or the fifteenth part of a Kṣipra), ŚBr. xii, 3, 2, 5.
एतादृ॑क्ष, एतादृ॑श्, and एतादृ॑श, mf(ई)n. such, such like, so formed, of this kind, similar to this, RV. viii, 102, 19; x, 27, 24; VS.; ŚBr. &c.
एतादृ॑क्ष, एतादृ॑श्, and एतादृ॑श, mf(ई)n. such, such like, so formed, of this kind, similar to this, RV. viii, 102, 19; x, 27, 24; VS.; ŚBr. &c.
एतादृ॑क्ष, एतादृ॑श्, and एतादृ॑श, mf(ई)n. such, such like, so formed, of this kind, similar to this, RV. viii, 102, 19; x, 27, 24; VS.; ŚBr. &c.
एतावच् (by Sandhi for एता॑वत् below).
एतावच्—छ॑स् (˚त्-शस्) ind. so many times, so often, MaitrS. i, 9, 8.
एता॑वत् mfn. so great, so much, so many, of such a measure or compass, of such extent, so far, of such quality or kind, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.

(often in connection with a relative clause, the latter generally following; एतावान् एव पुरुषो यज् जायात्मा प्रजा, a man is of such measure as [i.e. made complete by] his wife, himself, and his progeny, Mn. ix, 45), R.; BhP.; Hit. &c.
एता॑वत् ind. so far, thus far, so much, in such a degree, thus, RV. vii, 57, 3; ŚBr.; Hit. &c.
एतावतिथ mf(ई)n. the so-manieth (v.l. ˚तिम), Drāhy., Sch.
एतावत्—त्व n. the being so great or so much, quantity, number, size, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 15; BhP. &c.
(with following यद्, such a state or quantity &c., that.)
एतावद् (by Sandhi for एता॑वत्).
एतावद्-आवास mfn. having so many abodes, JaimUp.
एतावद्—धा॑ ind. so many fold, TS. vi.
एतावन् (by Sandhi for एता॑वत्).
एतावन्—मात्र॑ mfn. of this measure, of this quantity, so great, such, ŚBr.; MBh.
एतन m. expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the lungs, L.
the fish Silurus Pelorius, L.
